choose.when: SELECT CAST(purchase.id AS CHAR) AS documentId, purchase.version AS sourceVersion FROM biz_purchase_receipt receipt JOIN biz_purchase_request purchase ON purchase.tenant_id = receipt.tenant_id AND purchase.id = receipt.purchase_id AND purchase.deleted = 0 WHERE receipt.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receipt.id = #{sourceId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT CAST(request_id AS CHAR) AS documentId, version AS sourceVersion FROM oa_consumable_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{sourceId} AND deleted = 0

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND operation_key = #{key} ORDER BY operation_line_no
SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND consumable_id = #{consumableId} ORDER BY ledger_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND reversal_of_ledger_id = #{ledgerId}
SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND consumable_id = #{consumableId} AND ledger_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY ledger_id LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_ledger_id = #{ledgerId} ORDER BY ledger_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0.00) FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_biz_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND source_item_id = #{itemId} AND transaction_type = 'INBOUND'

SELECT ledger.unit_price FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ledger.consumable_id = #{consumableId} AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND ledger.transaction_type = 'INBOUND' AND ledger.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NULL AND ledger.quantity > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_consumable_ledger reversal WHERE reversal.tenant_id = ledger.tenant_id AND reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id = ledger.ledger_id) ORDER BY ledger.ledger_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_biz_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND source_item_id = #{itemId} AND transaction_type = 'INBOUND'

SELECT ledger.* FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ledger.consumable_id = #{consumableId} AND ledger.transaction_type IN ('INBOUND', 'ADJUST') AND ledger.quantity > 0 AND ledger.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_consumable_ledger reversal WHERE reversal.tenant_id = ledger.tenant_id AND reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id = ledger.ledger_id) ORDER BY ledger.ledger_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(material.consumable_id AS CHAR) AS consumable_id, material.name, material.unit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time < #{query.from} THEN ledger.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time >= #{query.from} AND ledger.quantity > 0 THEN ledger.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inbound_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time >= #{query.from} AND ledger.quantity < 0 THEN -ledger.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outbound_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(ledger.quantity), 0) AS closing_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time < #{query.from} THEN ledger.amount ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS opening_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time >= #{query.from} AND ledger.quantity > 0 THEN ledger.amount ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS inbound_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time >= #{query.from} AND ledger.quantity < 0 THEN -ledger.amount ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS outbound_amount, COALESCE(SUM(ledger.amount), 0.00) AS closing_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time >= #{query.from} AND ledger.transaction_type = 'INBOUND' THEN ledger.amount ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS inbound_cost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time >= #{query.from} AND ledger.transaction_type = 'SCRAP' THEN -ledger.amount ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS scrap_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.operate_time >= #{query.from} AND ledger.transaction_type = 'ADJUST' THEN ledger.amount ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS adjust_amount FROM oa_consumable material LEFT JOIN oa_consumable_ledger ledger ON ledger.tenant_id = material.tenant_id AND ledger.consumable_id = material.consumable_id AND ledger.operate_time < #{query.to} WHERE material.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND material.deleted = 0 AND material.consumable_id = #{query.consumableId} AND material.category_id = #{query.categoryId} GROUP BY material.consumable_id, material.name, material.unit ORDER BY material.consumable_id
